name: Ecommerce Analytics Explorer
prompt: make an interactive app that lists things to measure along the left, a large chart in the middle, and dimensions as filters above the chart. make the data oriented toward an ecommerce website

thought_process.interpretation: I interpreted the request as a 'Data Investigator' archetype. The user wants an exploratory interface where they can pivot between different business metrics (Total Sales, Order Volume, etc.) and filter the resulting trend analysis by dimensions (Order Status, Date Range). The 'left-hand list' serves as a metric switcher, while the top bar provides dimensional context.
assumed_from_scratch: Synthetic time-series aggregation helper for Recharts
thought_process.skill_suggestions: A specific 'Metric Selector' or 'Vertical Navigation' skill would be useful for standardized sidebars in analytical apps. Additionally, a 'Time Series Aggregator' utility skill could help handle raw-data to chart-data transformations more consistently.
